outcome: Changes in Newborn Infant Parasympathetic Evaluation (NIPE) index and heart rate
cohort: 49 infants admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit
finding: The NIPE index significantly decreased in the first 4 minutes after blood draws, particularly in preterm infants, those who had undergone repeated procedures, and those born via cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The decrease in NIPE values was greater in infants born via cesarean section.
